Segnala offerta di lavoro Siamo alla ricerca di un Direttore Sanitario da inserire presso la nostra Residenza Sanitaria Assistenziale L’Alba di Varazze (SV) , una realtà dedicata alla cura, all'assistenza e al benessere delle persone anziane. Situata in uno dei borghi più suggestivi della riviera ligure, la RSA L’Alba dispone di 67 posti letto, distribuiti su quattro piani e organizzati in nuclei assistenziali. La struttura offre un ambiente accogliente e confortevole, garantendo assistenza medica, infermieristica e riabilitativa a persone anziane con diversi livelli di non autosufficienza. Il professionista sarà responsabile: dell’andamento complessivo dell’assistenza sanitaria della struttura, affinché la medesima si esplichi in modo corretto ed adeguato alle necessità degli ospiti; degli aspetti igienico-sanitari della struttura, della completezza della cartella sanitaria, della supervisione sulla salute psico-fisica degli ospiti; della verifica del corretto funzionamento delle apparecchiature e attrezzature di ambito sanitario; della verifica del regolare approvvigionamento dei farmaci, presidi, protesi ed ausili per gli ospiti, nonché della regolare tenuta delle relative registrazioni; del raccordo e dell’armonizzazione degli interventi erogati dalle diverse componenti sanitarie, socio-sanitarie all’interno delle équipe multidisciplinari interne. Il presente annuncio è rivolto ad ambosessi. Contratto di lavoro: Tempo pieno, Part-time, Contratto con partita IVA. Istruzione: Laurea magistrale (o specialistica) (Preferenziale). title: Integration & Solution Specialist - Welfare
motivazione: Il requisito principale è gestire integrazioni B2B end‑to‑end; il candidato ha esperienza di project management e implementazione di pipeline HubSpot ma non ha gestito integrazioni API/fiscali tipiche del welfare/HR tech, quindi manca l'esperienza specifica richiesta. Altre competenze (analisi processi, comunicazione con stakeholder C‑level, budget) sono allineate.
testo_completo: Milan, Italy Hybrid About us Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance . That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what’s broken — you’ll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you’ll build something worth being proud of. What you’ll be doing As our Integration & Solution Specialist - Welfare , you’ll turn the needs of clients and partners into integrations that work, taking each one from the first discovery call to go-live. Here’s what that looks like in practice: Discovery - Lead discovery with clients and partners. Turn business needs and constraints into functional requirements and integration setups that last (API, file exchange, automations). Flow design - Design and document end-to-end flows in detail: data mapping, frequency, controls, exception handling and technical deliverables, working side by side with the development teams. Project management - Run integrations from start to finish. Set milestones, assign responsibilities, coordinate across teams, and keep track of progress, risks and dependencies. Testing and go-live - Oversee testing, validation and go-live. Handle blockers and escalations quickly, and hand over smoothly to the teams that run and support the integration day to day. Standardisation - Create guidelines, reusable templates and checklists, so delivery scales with less complexity and fewer custom interventions. Partner onboarding - Onboard and integrate strategic partners, merchants and HR/welfare platforms, keeping business logic and information systems aligned. Flexible benefits flows - Map and improve the operational flows of the flexible benefits ecosystem between Satispay, client companies and providers: employee records, allocations, transactions, reporting and data reconciliation. Sales and partnerships support - Support the sales and partnerships teams in qualifying opportunities, checking technical and functional feasibility and operational constraints before commercial agreements are signed. Continuous improvement - Collect recurring patterns and needs from the welfare ecosystem, spot what can be automated, and help improve product features. Who we’re looking for This role needs someone who takes an integration from the first requirements to a smooth go-live, and is just as comfortable talking to technical and non-technical people. Experience - At least 3 years managing B2B integrations, from requirements gathering to go-live. Functional analysis - Process mapping and design of end-to-end operational flows. Integration know-how - Familiarity with APIs, file exchange, data mapping, authentication and data quality checks. Communication - You talk with technical and non-technical people, and weight constraints, alternatives and operational impact. You don’t need to be a developer. Autonomy - You handle standard integrations on your own, love solving problems, and ask for support on the most complex cases. Organisation - Good organisational skills and a knack for managing priorities. Nice to have - Experience in the welfare ecosystem, flexible benefits, HR tech or payroll, in standardising and automating integration processes, and in managing external vendors and partners and coordinating cross-functional projects. Don’t worry if you don’t tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you’re passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply. CareAbout: how we support your impact We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. testo_completo: International Commercial Growth Manager International Commercial Growth Manager Medtronic Milan, Lombardy, Italy 8 minutes ago Be among the first 25 applicants See who Medtronic has hired for this role Apply Join or sign in to find your next job Join to apply for the International Commercial Growth Manager role at Medtronic Email or phone Password Show Forgot password? Sign in Sign in with Email or New to LinkedIn? Join now By clicking Continue to join or sign in, you agree to LinkedIn’s User Agreement , Privacy Policy , and Cookie Policy . Save Report this job Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact. A Day in the Life As the International Commercial Growth Manager within the International Commercial Marketing team, you will bridge marketing and sales, translate global strategy into measurable account-level growth for Medtronic InterStim™ SNM therapy, help prepare markets for future therapies, and report to the Senior Manager, International Marketing. Working in close partnership with Enterprise Accounts (EA), Integrated Health Solutions (IHS), Business Development (BD), and regional commercial teams, you will help accelerate strategic account growth by identifying and scaling opportunities that create value for providers, healthcare systems, and patients including the assessment of emerging technologies that have a strategic fit within the Pelvic health portfolio. This role focuses on expanding therapy adoption and utilization within existing and new accounts, enabling competitive conversion and market share growth, and developing scalable commercial growth programs and value propositions that create clinical, operational, and economic value across the customer journey. Success will come from building compelling hospital business cases around ROI, pathway efficiency, and system-level outcomes, supporting pelvic health pathway expansion, identifying new customer segments and partnership opportunities, and creating innovative growth models, tools, and solutions that can be scaled across markets. The ideal candidate brings previous field sales experience and a strong marketing and market development mindset, with the ability to translate customer insights into differentiated value propositions, strategic growth initiatives, and sustainable business opportunities that strengthen Medtronic's position within strategic accounts and evolving healthcare ecosystems. Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned. Own the installed base growth strategy across existing accounts for pelvic health and Medtronic InterStim SNM therapy by defining segmentation based on adoption, utilization, and growth potential, identifying pathway expansion opportunities, and building scalable frameworks that help regions increase procedure volume, expand into new indications or departments, and strengthen SNM-portfolio penetration. Design and deploy repeatable account growth playbooks that regions can execute consistently, including utilization growth programs, pathway optimization, referral activation, and structured transformation toolkits that move accounts from low to high utilization. Enable competitive conversion and market share gain in priority accounts by owning competitive intelligence, defining clear differentiation versus key competitors, and developing evidence-based tender narratives, objection-handling frameworks, battle cards, economic value stories, and a competitive response library that equips regions to respond consistently and win in the field. Partner with regional and country teams across Business Development, Sales, Enterprise Accounts, Field Market Development, Clinical, Integrated Health Solutions, and Marketing. Serve as a strategic partner for priority accounts by aligning growth plans and driving targeted initiatives. Translate global strategy into relevant field action that expands pelvic health pathways, reaches new stakeholders, and drives growth through influence. Build strong value-based growth narratives that translate clinical evidence, portfolio strengths, and pathway efficiency into compelling business cases for hospital ROI, tailored to clinicians, procurement stakeholders, and hospital leadership involved in complex system-level buying decisions, while driving value beyond the product through pathway transformation, service-oriented solutions, and broader system-level impact. Act as a market builder by shaping pelvic health pathway adoption, strengthening InterStim SNM competitive positioning, and supporting key opinion leader development. In partnership with Business Development, Enterprise Accounts, and Integrated Health Solutions, identify and scale customer-centric value propositions, technologies, services, digital tools, and partnership models that fit the Pelvic Health portfolio and accelerate growth in priority accounts and healthcare systems. Identify, develop, and implement near-term and long-term business strategies for new products, technologies, services, follow-on products, and opportunities in adjacent industries that fit the Pelvic Health portfolio. Identify new markets and licensing opportunities, and assess the feasibility of business and product development opportunities in partnership with relevant internal functions. Perform economic analyses of new or improved product opportunities to inform business cases and development decisions Develop business models and evaluate market trends to substantiate the long-term prospects of new business and product opportunities. Work with Sales, Marketing, and potential customers to understand their needs and translate these insights into business and product development opportunities. Drive execution discipline through clear growth KPIs and ownership of CRM standards, using dashboards and AI-enabled analytics to identify growth opportunities, track leading indicators, utilization trends, share evolution, competitive win/loss dynamics, and program adoption across regions. Translate these insights into smarter decisions, stronger marketing and sales alignment, and continuous refinement of initiatives to ensure activity delivers measurable commercial impact. Develop and share regular progress updates with all relevant stakeholders on the fulfillment of business development project goals and objectives. Required Knowledge and Experience: +10 years of experience in MedTech or Pharma, with exposure across sales, marketing, strategic accounts, market development, commercial excellence, or related customer-facing and growth-driving functions. Proven track record in account growth, therapy expansion, and increasing share of wallet within existing accounts, ideally within pelvic health, SNM, or adjacent care pathways, with strong understanding of how to unlock utilization, expand pathways, and build markets rather than relying solely on new account acquisition. Demonstrated ability to translate strategy into structured field execution, influence across functions without authority, and work effectively in cross-functional environments spanning Sales, Marketing, Clinical, and Market Development, including preparing organizations for future therapies and creating new customer segments. Strong experience engaging complex hospital stakeholders and multi-stakeholder buying groups, with the ability to influence system-level decisions through evidence-driven clinical and economic value messaging, including ROI and pathway efficiency arguments. Strategic, data-driven, and commercially minded profile with strong capabilities in competitive positioning, KOL development, pelvic health market shaping, project leadership, prioritization, and the use of insights and KPIs to drive decisions, performance, and future growth platform expansion. Success in this role will be measured by growth in procedure volume and utilization in key accounts, expansion of share of wallet, competitive conversion rate, adoption of account growth playbooks across regions, pelvic health pathway expansion, creation of new customer segments, and the contribution of commercial growth programs to revenue growth and market share expansion. Saleance® è la boutique di Head Hunting verticalmente specializzata nella ricerca, identificazione e selezione di leadership direzionali e ruoli strategici nella funzione commerciale. About Our Client Per una delle principali multiutility italiane quotate in borsa, con oltre 20 anni di storia e milioni di clienti serviti tra gas naturale ed energia elettrica, ricerchiamo un/a Responsabile Comunicazione Commerciale da inserire nella società di vendita energia del gruppo. Key Responsibilities A diretto riporto della Responsabile Marketing Comunicazione ed Eventi, e interfacciandosi con l'AD, la figura sarà il punto di riferimento per l'ideazione e la governance della comunicazione commerciale del brand, con particolare focus sul target consumer/mass market (B2C) e su scala nazionale: Ideare, pianificare e supervisionare da zero campagne di comunicazione commerciale integrate, con forte presidio su canali ATL (inclusa la produzione e messa in onda di spot TV), e in misura minore BTL e digital; Coordinare un team interno di 3-4 persone e gestire il budget assegnato; Definire i brief strategici e guidare operativamente i centri media, le agenzie creative e i partner di produzione, garantendo qualità, tempi e risultati; Raccordarsi costantemente con le strutture di Go-to-Market, Marketing di Prodotto, Sales, Digital Marketing ed Eventi per garantire piena coerenza comunicativa. Job Requirements Key Skills : Esperienza consolidata in ruoli di Responsabile Comunicazione / Communication Manager, con focus specifico sulla comunicazione commerciale B2C/Consumer; Provenienza da aziende strutturate (minimo 500 dipendenti) operanti nei settori Energy / Multiutility o Telecomunicazioni; Esperienza diretta nell'ideazione e coordinamento di campagne pubblicitarie televisive (spot TV) e multimediali nazionali; Esperienza consolidata nella gestione di team, budget, agenzie e fornitori; Competenze di comunicazione corporate, brand management, campagne integrate e project management. Complementary Skills Laurea in Marketing, Comunicazione, Economia o discipline affini; Spiccate capacità organizzative e di leadership; Elevato standing relazionale con differenti stakeholder e C-Level. Orientamento ai risultati e approccio proattivo. Other Info Location: Possibilità di scelta tra le sedi di Imola, Padova, Treviso, Venezia, Udine o Trieste. Modalità di lavoro ibrida (8-9 giorni/mese di smart working). Possibilità di supporto alla relocation, se necessaria, da parte dell'azienda. Contract Offered CCNL Gas Acqua, tempo indeterminato. Compensation RAL compresa tra 55-65K, in funzione dell'effettiva esperienza maturata, premio di risultato (€ 3000), possibilità di bonus individuale (10% della RAL), wefare aziendale pari a 400 €/anno, formazione continua, mensa aziendale. Segnala offerta di lavoro Vibram Group ha fornito un livello di retribuzione Questo livello è fornito da Vibram Group. La tua retribuzione effettiva sarà basata sulle tue competenze e la tua esperienza. Rivolgiti al tuo recruiter per saperne di più. Livello retribuzione di base 80.000,00 €/yr - 90.000,00 €/anno Tipi di retribuzione aggiuntivi Bonus annuale Invia un messaggio diretto all’autore dell’offerta di lavoro da Vibram Group Paola Borghesi Paola Borghesi Vibram is looking for talented and motivated people, future leaders to join our global team. Are you connected to the footwear world? Are you the kind of person who takes the initiative to help move tasks and projects ahead? Are you interested in developing a career with a great company that grows its people, as well as the brand? Consider joining the Vibram team, where you will find great talent, industry-leading products, a global culture of innovation, and dedication to growing the business. Come along on the journey and help us reach our destination. Vibram is a culture of growth. People are the most important element of the company culture here. The Vibram team consists of employees with a wide variety of talents, backgrounds, and experiences. We develop future leaders through our training and development program, building relationships, working in a global environment, and connecting with brands that choose to partner with Vibram on their products. Purpose Vibram FiveFingers sparks a whole way of moving: barefoot-inspired, curious, a little rebellious, and loved by a passionate community around the world. Now we’re looking for the person who will take that story to its next chapter. As Global Head of Marketing, you’ll set the creative and strategic direction for the brand and lead a talented global team to bring it to life. You’ll be a leader who inspires people and still loves to get close to the work, rolling up your sleeves on the campaigns, launches, and big moments where your instinct and experience make the difference. We are looking for a brand or marketing leader, ideally with a background in sport and lifestyle. Experienced in leading international teams and getting the best from agency partners. A hands-on leader who’s equally at home setting strategy and diving into the details. Creative at heart, with the analytical rigor to back ideas with KPIs and ROI. Fluent in seasonal GTM planning, product drops, and retail moments. Culturally curious, with a natural feel for social and digital storytelling. A warm, clear communicator who builds trust across teams and functions Main Responsibilities Shape the vision Craft an integrated marketing and communication strategy that honors the brand’s culture and speaks to the moment we’re living in Be the guardian of the FiveFingers identity, setting the creative vision and standards for how it meets the world Partner with the BU GM to define our strategic marketing ambitions and keep every market pulling in the same direction Bring our seasons to life Team up with the Head of Global Product and Merchandising to build the GTM process and choose the seasonal stories and drops that land at the right retail moments Turn marketing insights into clear, useful in-season guidance that helps our commercial teams sell with confidence Work with Product colleagues to turn consumer and market insights into fresh, bold ideas Grow our community Set the plan for reaching new audiences and getting more people into FiveFingers Guide our social storytelling and activations, keeping an eye on the KPIs that tell us what’s resonating Steer our Media and PR agencies with great briefs and a clear point of view Make every investment count Define the annual budget and allocate it wisely across markets, tailoring campaigns and messaging locally Track results and ROI, and share the story of what’s working with leadership Inspire and grow a great team Lead, coach, and energize a global team, helping each person do the best work of their career Set clear priorities, trust your people to deliver, and celebrate the wins together Stay hands-on where it counts: shaping campaigns, sharpening creative, and showing up for key launches Build bridges Nurture strong partnerships with colleagues across the business so we move quickly, together Reporting The role reports to the Global Business Unit Manager. Workplace: Milan offices (Italy) Skills Integrated campaign strategy: connecting brand, digital, PR, retail, and community into one coherent, high-impact plan Go-to-market and seasonal planning: building product-drop calendars and launch moments that drive sell-through Brand storytelling and creative direction: a sharp eye for what makes a brand distinctive, and the ability to guide creative work to a high standard Team leadership and talent development: coaching, motivating, and empowering a global team while delegating with confidence Social and community-led marketing: a natural feel for platforms, creators, and cultural trends that turn fans into advocates Agency and partner management: writing strong briefs and getting the best from media, PR, and creative partners Consumer insight and data-driven decision making: using research, analytics, and KPIs to sharpen targeting and prove ROI Cross-functional influence and communication: building trust and alignment with executives, Product, Sales, and regional teams What we offer Direct hiring into the company A young, stimulating, collaborative environment The history and heritage of a universally recognized brand Annual total compensation package: yearly gross salary range between 80.000€ and 90.000€, plus 15% MBO. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro Job Description Europe Head of Digital Product As a EU Head of Digital Product , you will lead the digital product vision and execution across our European business, transforming how partners, dealers, and customers connect with our financial solutions. Leading a cross-functional team of product managers, design specialists, and digital analysts, you will turn strategic opportunities into seamless, market-leading experiences that support sustainable asset finance. Your Mission Lead (Executing): Set and execute the end-to-end digital product strategy for the Europe market, translating commercial priorities into an impactful multi-year roadmap. Lead & Mentor (Executing): Directly lead, inspire, and develop a diverse team of 9 digital professionals spanning product management, user experience, channel operations, and digital analytics. Drive (Executing): Oversee full customer and partner lifecycle products, maximizing conversion rates, self-service efficiency, and post-booking digital services. Champion (Influencing): Drive circular economy and sustainable finance capabilities within our digital touchpoints to advance DLL’s commitment to sustainable business. Partner (Influencing): Steer digital product alignment and tailored digital integrations for strategic business partnerships and joint venture programs (including AGCO Finance and Polaris). Collaborate (Influencing & Participating): align global standards with local customer engagement needs. Optimize (Executing): Steer user experience (UI/UX) standards and leverage digital insight analytics to continuously validate hypotheses, measure user satisfaction, and elevate digital performance. Align (Influencing & Participating): Partner closely with commercial leaders, enterprise technology teams, and global product communities to ensure cohesive delivery and seamless integration. Skills And Capabilities Required Digital Product Leadership: 10+ years of progressive experience leading digital product management, product strategy, or digital transformation teams. People Leadership: Proven track record of managing, coaching, and developing multidisciplinary teams across product, design, and analytics. Lifecycle & Funnel Optimization: Practical experience defining and optimizing customer journeys, from acquisition and onboarding through post-origination servicing. Strategic Stakeholder Engagement: Demonstrated ability to influence executive stakeholders, commercial leaders, and key external corporate partners. Platform & Ecosystem Integration: Experience integrating enterprise platforms (such as CRM and core servicing systems) and scaling joint-venture or partner-specific solutions. Data-Informed Decision Making: Strong comfort using quantitative analytics and qualitative customer feedback to guide backlog prioritization and measure business outcomes. Collaborative & Agile Mindset: An inclusive, adaptable approach to navigating complex matrix organizations and bridging global strategy with local market needs. Growth Orientation: A continuous learning mindset with openness to exploring emerging technologies, sustainable business practices, and modern digital delivery methods. All members enjoy Work-Life Balance: Flexible working, including hybrid, designed to support you at every stage of life. and Inclusive Culture: A and inclusive culture where your unique background and perspectives are valued. Two volunteering days: Two working days to contribute to charities and your community. Comprehensive Benefits: Health, wellness, and financial programs and industry leading holiday package. Professional Growth: Access to training, mentorship, tuition reimbursement, and career development programs tailored to your goals. Click this link to look at the benefits in your region. Choose Wellbeing At DLL, We Recognize That Investing In Member Wellbeing Is Essential For Creating An Inclusive And Supportive Work Environment. This Not Only Promotes Personal And Professional Growth But Also Boosts Productivity, Engagement, And Overall Success. We Focus On The Following Supporting Members During Moments That Matter: We provide dedicated support resources to help you navigate significant events in your work, your lifestyle, and your personal moments. Implementing Global Wellbeing Programs: We carefully select and implement programs that enhance our member’s experience. Embedding Wellbeing in Everything We Do: We integrate wellbeing into all our practices and policies to ensure it is a fundamental part of our culture. Good To Know Deadline for application: December 31st The selection process may involve an assessment. For more information, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Omnia Hassan via omnia.hassan@dllgroup.com DLL is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to inclusive, barrier-free recruitment and selection processes and an inclusive work environment. We’re dedicated to ensuring our hiring process is accessible to all. If you require accommodation at any stage, please inform your HR Partner. About Us DLL, a great place to build your career DLL is a global asset finance company that partners with manufacturers, dealers, distributors, and end users to facilitate access to equipment and technology. Headquartered in Eindhoven, the Netherlands, we operate in over 25 countries, offering financial solutions across various industries. We are also a 100% subsidiary of our parent company Rabobank, one of the world’s largest financial companies. Join our community of over 6.000 members from 75 nationalities! At DLL, our unique culture — shaped by our values (We put our customers first -Together we achieve more-You can count on me - I challenge myself and others to grow) and behaviors that define us — is at the heart of everything we do. We offer exciting job opportunities where you feel welcomed, respected and empowered to be your authentic self and share your best ideas. At DLL, we believe in the strength of our diverse perspectives and experiences, which make our global community thrive. You’ll receive competitive pay, generous benefits, health and wellbeing support, and manage your work-life balance through our hybrid working flexibility. Our global operations offer you a variety of development opportunities and we encourage you to take on new challenges across our departments, businesses and regions. Our company strategy emphasizes our commitment to sustainable business and making social impact is part of that as well. Together, we’ll “Partner for a better world” to make a positive impact. Joining DLL, means joining a company that consistently scores higher than the industry average in Employee Engagement surveys. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards. In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other. For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate. A few examples of your responsibilities Shape the B2B sales function. Joining a fast-moving team building a world-class B2B sales function, you’ll help define the strategy, approach, and guiding principles that set a new standard for excellence in enterprise sales. Curate high-potential leads. Build a portfolio of revenue-driving corporate clients, leveraging the latest AI tools to prioritize where you invest your time for long-term growth. Learn the industry inside and out. Understand the incentives, pressure points, and decision-makers of your industry so you can build powerful, profitable relationships. Be a credible voice for the product. Speak about it with clarity and confidence. Gather feedback from clients and share insights to help shape future development. Follow the data. Keep a close eye on performance metrics to gauge impact and zero in on the highest-value actions and opportunities. Stand out at every touchpoint. Deliver outstanding service that builds trust with every client interaction. What we look for Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter. Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar. Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent. Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English. What we offer Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field. An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too. All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work. Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £68,579 to £112,189 in London and from €54,346 to €82,557 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity. Commitment & contract Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time. Location Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland). The selection process In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process. Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject. All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here. We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times. We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form. Before you apply If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again. Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment. To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage. If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you. L’Azienda Cliente e i Suoi Valori La cultura aziendale si basa sull’innovazione tecnologica, l’affidabilità e la trasparenza, pertanto, ci rivolgiamo a persone che condividano tali valori, persone flessibili e orientate alle crescita. L’azienda investe costantemente in innovazione e ricerca al fine di ottimizzare, validare e scoprire nuove metodiche atte al miglioramento del risultato terapeutico e della salute del paziente. Posizione ATTIVITÀ / RESPONSABILITÀ A diretto riporto della direzione, la risorsa si occuperà di gestire e implementare i mercati USA. Sarà responsabile di implementare strategie commerciali efficaci, sviluppare relazioni con i distributori locali, e coordinare l’espansione del marchio nell'area di riferimento. Analizzare i mercati di riferimento, studiando la domanda, la concorrenza e le normative locali. Ricercare nuovi dealers e distributori sul mercato di riferimento e condurre la fase di trattativa. Gestire, monitorare e sviluppare la rete di distributori esistenti, al fine di garantire il rispetto degli obiettivi minimi di fatturato o quantità vendute e gli standard di comunicazione e qualità del servizio con il cliente. Sviluppare e implementare strategie di vendita. Supportare il dealer nell’organizzazione di corsi di formazione rivolti al cliente finale. Negoziare contratti e accordi commerciali con distributori e partner locali. Gestire offerte, inserimento degli ordini, monitoraggio dello stato di avanzamento dell’ordine, sollecitare pagamenti, coordinandosi con l’amministrazione. Partecipare a fiere di settore e a iniziative locali strategiche. Gestire, insieme al reparto assistenza, eventuali richieste sui macchinari venduti. Requisiti Pregressa esperienza di almeno 5 anni maturati come Export Manager o in ruoli commerciali esteri per aziende operanti nel settore medicale. Esperienza pregressa nel mercato USA. Pregressa esperienza nella gestione di trattative commerciali con clienti e/o distributori esteri. Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese (scritta e parlata). Buon utilizzo del pacchetto Office. Ottime capacità commerciali e propensione al lavoro in team. Proattività e propensione allo studio degli aspetti tecnici del prodotto. Orientamento al lavoro per obiettivi. Altre Informazioni ORARIO Full Time Dalle 08:00 alle 17:00 (flessibilità oraria) - Dal lunedì al venerdì. Dopo un primo periodo iniziale, disponibili 1-2 giorni di smartworking a settimana. INQUADRAMENTO CCNL Metalmeccanico Piccola e Media Industria (Confapi), Contratto a tempo indeterminato. RETRIBUZIONE/RAL €50.000-70.000 + premi; sono previsti buoni pasto. Il nostro Cliente, importante Gruppo Italiano leader nel settore alimentare e riconosciuto a livello internazionale, ci ha incaricati di cercare il: Chief Executive Officer (CEO) La risorsa, a diretto riporto del Presidente della Società, guiderà una struttura manageriale composta da circa dieci primi riporti, assumendo la responsabilità di accompagnare il Gruppo in una nuova fase di crescita profittevole, espansione internazionale e rafforzamento organizzativo." Principali attività e responsabilità : Contribuire alla definizione e guidare l'attuazione delle strategie di medio-lungo periodo e del piano industriale Sviluppare fatturato e redditività attraverso innovazione, ampliamento del portafoglio prodotti e apertura di nuovi mercati Rafforzare la presenza sui mercati esteri, cogliendo opportunità commerciali e strategiche Valutare opportunità di acquisizioni, partnership e operazioni sul capitale Garantire il raggiungimento degli obiettivi, presidiando marginalità, generazione di cassa e sostenibilità degli investimenti Promuovere produttività, ottimizzazione dei processi e miglioramento continuo Consolidare il percorso di managerializzazione, valorizzando le competenze e sviluppando una prima linea manageriale coesa e responsabilizzata Operare con ampia autonomia gestionale, nel rispetto delle deleghe e dei budget approvati dal CdA, sviluppando un rapporto basato su fiducia, trasparenza e confronto costruttivo. Valorizzare la storia e l'identità dell'impresa familiare, accompagnandone l'evoluzione verso un modello sempre più manageriale, fondato su meritocrazia, accountability e orientamento ai risultati. Requisiti : Laurea in discipline economiche o ingegneristiche 30 + anni di esperienza professionale di cui 10 nel ruolo di Amministratore Delegato maturati in contesti produttivi preferibilmente Food e in realtà a forte impronta imprenditoriale Significativa esperienza commerciale nei mercati italiani e internazionali Esperienza nella gestione di trasformazioni organizzative e culturali Esperienza diretta nella conduzione di acquisizioni e operazioni straordinarie sul capitale Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese, è considerato un plus la conoscenza di un’altra lingua straniera Pacchetto retributivo : La retribuzione, oltre al base salary sarà composta da più elementi, in relazione anche al target di obiettivi che verranno raggiunti. Il base salary sarà a partire da Euro 200.000. Entrerai a far parte di PLAS – Platform Architecture Strategy , la Value Line di BIP dedicata all’Enterprise Architecture , specializzata nella definizione di architetture enterprise moderne e nell’abilitazione di percorsi di evoluzione digitale. Il Ruolo Realizzare contenuti creativi, partendo dall'idea, passando per i testi, i concept visivi, le risorse grafiche, i modelli e fino alla produzione finale; Gestire la presenza sui social media come LinkedIn, Instagram e YouTube: pianificare i calendari editoriali, scrivere e adattare i contenuti per ogni piattaforma, ottimizzare le performance sui social media monitorando i dati e perfezionando continuamente formati, messaggi e tempistiche per massimizzare il coinvolgimento; Con l'aiuto di consulenti esterni, progettare, gestire e ottimizzare campagne pubblicitarie su diversi canali digitali, inclusi i social media a pagamento (LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads), e canali basati su LLM, gestire i budget delle campagne e monitorare le prestazioni rispetto ai KPI definiti; Gestire progressivamente maggiori responsabilità nell'organizzazione degli eventi: dall'ideazione e pianificazione alla logistica, al coordinamento delle parti interessate e all'esecuzione in loco, compresi eventi per i clienti. Job Requirements Requisiti primari: Esperienza di 3-5 anni in ruoli simili, incentrati sulla comunicazione e branding aziendale oppure sull'analisi delle performance delle campagne di comunicazione; Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese, scritta e parlata; Comprovata esperienza nello sviluppo di contenuti di comunicazione a 360°: dalla definizione della strategia al copywriting, fino all'ideazione visiva e alla realizzazione grafica (utilizzando Claude Design, Canva, Adobe Suite o strumenti simili); Conoscenza approfondita delle piattaforme di social media, in particolare LinkedIn, Instagram e YouTube, inclusi i relativi algoritmi, formati, pubblico e best practices; Comprovata capacità di lettura e analisi dei dati, di interpretazione delle performance e di conseguente orientamento delle scelte di comunicazione (una solida conoscenza degli strumenti di analisi come Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Analytics, Google Analytics, Google Search Console o simili rappresenta un plus). Requisiti Secondari Familiarità con gli strumenti di intelligenza artificiale per la generazione di contenuti, la ricerca e l'automazione dei flussi di lavoro; Conoscenza autentica e passione per i temi della sostenibilità, con particolare attenzione alle tendenze, ai temi chiave e alle opportunità che questi creano per le imprese, dalle certificazioni B Corp alla CSRD, dai modelli di business rigenerativi alla rendicontazione dell'impatto. Other Info Sede di lavoro: Milano. Tipo di impiego: full-time con modalità ibrida. CCNL applicato: Commercio. Trattamento economico: RAL compresa tra 30.000€ e 35.000€, in funzione dell'effettiva esperienza maturata. Segnala offerta di lavoro Entra nel nostro mondo. Trasforma insieme a noi. Quale sarà la tua sfida? Siamo il partner strategico e operativo preferenziale per i nostri clienti in ogni Paese in cui operano, aiutandoli a innovare attraverso nuove tecnologie e nuovi modelli di business. La nostra Practice Consulting è nata nel 2003 e sta crescendo per confermarsi tra le migliori 30 al mondo. Facciamo tutto il necessario per aiutare i nostri clienti affrontare nuove sfide competitive e trasformare il loro business, attraverso: La progettazione di roadmap di trasformazione Il supporto nelle decisioni aziendali e tecnologiche, in un momento in cui si può fare quasi tutto Il coordinamento dei nostri Centri di Eccellenza nello sviluppo di prototipi e progetti pilota La progettazione dell'architettura tecnologica e organizzativa per realizzare innovazione su larga scala Lo sviluppo di business case a breve e medio termine L’applicazione di metodologie Agile nelle fasi di progettazione e implementazione La realizzazione di programmi di trasformazione d’impatto. Vuoi scoprire altre informazioni sulla Practice? Click here! Enterprise Architect & IT Strategy - Manager Guida strategie architetturali che abilitano l’innovazione e la trasformazione del business. Hai una solida esperienza in Enterprise Architecture e cerchi un ruolo di responsabilità, in cui contribuire in prima linea alla definizione delle strategie di evoluzione tecnologica delle imprese? Entrerai a far parte di PLAS – Platform Architecture Strategy , la Value Line di BIP specializzata in Enterprise Architecture. Lavorerai su progetti complessi per grandi organizzazioni, guidando la definizione di architetture enterprise evolutive che abilitano l’innovazione, supportano la trasformazione digitale e rendono sostenibile lo sviluppo dei modelli di business. Vuoi saperne di più? Prosegui nella lettura di questa job description e applica. La tua challenge Analizzare trend tecnologici e soluzioni emergenti, valutandone impatti architetturali, organizzativi e operativi; Guidare la definizione di scenari evolutivi, linee guida e soluzioni architetturali a livello enterprise, in grado di abilitare trasformazioni trasversali su processi, applicazioni e tecnologie; Interagire con stakeholder di business e IT (anche C-Level) nella definizione di roadmap architetturali e nell’adozione di nuove tecnologie; Costruire blueprint architetturali articolati (processi, applicazioni, dati, tecnologie) per abilitare l’evoluzione dei modelli operativi; Coordinare assessment applicativi, due diligence IT e strategie di integrazione post-merger; Definire business case a supporto delle decisioni architetturali e della valutazione costi/benefici; Supportare lo startup o l’evoluzione delle funzioni di Enterprise Architecture presso i clienti, contribuendo a definirne mission, modello operativo e strumenti; Presidiare l’evoluzione delle architetture nel tempo, garantendo coerenza rispetto ai principi e ai framework di riferimento; Promuovere la crescita della community interna attraverso attività di coaching, condivisione metodologica e sviluppo di asset architetturali; Contribuire all’evoluzione dell’offerta EA di PLAS, partecipando alla codifica di framework, acceleratori e approcci progettuali Sede di assunzione: Milano Il tuo profilo Hai almeno 6 anni di esperienza in progetti di Enterprise Architecture e IT Strategy, maturata in società di consulenza o aziende strutturate; Hai una visione sistemica del contesto enterprise, con capacità di sintesi e astrazione; Conosci i principali paradigmi architetturali (SOA, API, microservizi, event-driven, container, ecc.); Hai familiarità con strumenti di modellazione architetturale (UML, BPMN, Archi, ecc.); Sei in grado di guidare la definizione di soluzioni architetturali complesse e di presentarle a stakeholder anche non tecnici; Hai dimestichezza con la costruzione di business case e l’analisi costi/benefici degli interventi architetturali; Hai esperienza nel coordinare team progettuali e facilitare processi decisionali architetturali complessi; Sei orientato al miglioramento continuo e all’innovazione, aggiornandoti costantemente su tecnologie, trend e best practice; Hai ottime doti comunicative e relazionali, anche in contesti ad alta visibilità; Parli e scrivi fluentemente in inglese. Nice to have Certificazioni su metodologie di Enterprise Architecture (es. TOGAF®); Conoscenza di framework di IT governance e gestione del ciclo di vita applicativo (es. COBIT®, ITIL®); Certificazioni o esperienza con metodologie di project delivery (Agile, Scrum, PMP®); Familiarità con ambienti cloud, architetture ibride e moderni paradigmi di integrazione (API, microservizi, DevOps); Esperienza con tool di modellazione architetturale (es. ArchiMate, Draw.io, LeanIX, Bizzdesign, Mega International, Avolution Abacus, ecc.); Conoscenza delle principali piattaforme enterprise (ERP, CRM, WMS, TMS…) e dei relativi ecosistemi applicativi. Entrare in PLAS significa contribuire all’evoluzione di una practice di eccellenza, mettendo a valore la tua esperienza per guidare progetti strategici e accompagnare le imprese nella trasformazione tecnologica e organizzativa. Se vuoi fare la differenza, questo è il tuo prossimo passo. Candidati ora. Perché scegliere BIP In BIP mettiamo le persone al centro. Offriamo un ambiente sfidante e meritocratico, dove la collaborazione e lo spirito imprenditoriale vengono valorizzati ogni giorno. Inclusione e Valori Promuoviamo l’unicità e garantiamo pari opportunità a tutte le persone. Next Steps Una volta ricevuto il tuo cv ci prenderemo del tempo per valutarlo attentamente. Artificialy is an AI company based in Switzerland, with offices in Lugano and Zurich. We design and deliver AI solutions that are impactful, transparent, and tailored to real-world industry needs. Founded in 2020 by pioneers with over 40 years of combined experience in the field, our team brings together talented engineers, physicists, and mathematicians from across Europe. We are driven by curiosity, technical excellence, and a shared ambition to build AI systems that make a tangible difference. We are looking for a Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead all financial activities of Artificialy and play a key role in supporting the company’s growth and long-term strategy. Reporting to the CEO, the CFO will lead a small finance team, consisting of one Accounting & Admin Specialist, and will work closely with the management team and external advisors, combining strategic financial leadership with a hands-on approach to day-to-day operations. Previous CFO experience is not essential: we also welcome candidates who have been Head of Finance, Finance Director or held other senior finance roles, ideally in ICT/technology companies, startups or scale-ups. About the Role Financial Strategy & Growth: Define and implement the company’s financial strategy in line with business objectives, acting as a strategic partner to the CEO and management team. Support the growth strategy by evaluating business opportunities, investments, financial risks and funding needs. Planning, Budgeting & Performance: Lead the annual budgeting, financial planning and forecasting processes, including personnel costs and bonus pool planning. Develop and monitor financial KPIs, analyze business performance and provide actionable recommendations to support management decisions. Operational Business & Line Support: Support Business Line and Project Managers with pricing models, project margin tracking and active budget management across business units. Work closely with department heads to strengthen budget ownership and cost monitoring. Financial Management & Reporting: Ensure accurate and timely financial reporting, management accounts and financial statements. Monitor cash flow, liquidity, working capital, operating costs and profitability, so that resources are allocated efficiently. Financial Operations & Governance: Oversee accounting, invoicing, accounts payable and receivable, and payroll-related financial processes. Manage relationships with external accounting and tax advisors. Establish financial processes, policies and internal controls that comply with Swiss regulatory and accounting requirements. The role also requires to work onsite at least 80% of the time. Qualifications and Skills: Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration or a related field. At least 8 years of professional experience in finance, with experience in a senior financial management position (e.g. Head of Finance, Finance Director, Senior Finance Manager, Senior Controller or CFO). Proven experience in financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, cash flow management and financial reporting. Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial controls and Swiss financial and tax regulations. Experience managing relationships with external accounting, tax and financial advisors. Ability to translate financial data into business insights and support strategic decision-making. Hands-on experience with ERP and accounting systems (e.g. Abacus, SAP, etc.). Strong analytical, organizational and leadership skills, with a hands-on and proactive approach. Fluency in Italian and English. Business Analyst - Digital International Projects Data: 11 nov 2026 Località: Milano, IT Società: Intesa Sanpaolo S.p.A. . Overview Entrerai nel team dei Digital Business Partner e contribuirai alla trasformazione digitale della International Bank Division di Intesa Sanpaolo. Ti occuperai di gestire con proattività, autonomia e propensione al risultato alcune tra le più rilevanti e articolate progettualità innovative. Sarai chiamato a creare solide relazioni di partnership sia con i referenti di business, sia con i team applicativi, al fine di individuare le più efficaci ed efficienti modalità per il raggiungimento gli obiettivi del Piano Industriale. Quali saranno le tue attività Ccomprendere le esigenze di business, supportando l'individuazione delle migliori soluzioni tecnologiche per perseguirle Partecipare proattivamente alla gestione di stream progettuali, garantendo e monitorando l'avanzamento dei lavori nel rispetto degli obiettivi di progetto, in termini di tempi, costi e qualità Intercettare eventuali punti di attenzione, individuando le opportune soluzioni Guidare proattivamente la definizione dei requisiti di business in linea con la strategia definita, ricercando possibili leve di semplificazione, innovazione e trasformazione digitale Gestire E2E gli investimenti progettuali, in ottica di identificare possibili sinergie ed efficienze Contribuire in prima persona alla predisposizione di documenti ufficiali di progetto e per il Top Management Chi stiamo cercando Se hai le seguenti caratteristiche, ti stiamo aspettando: Esperienza di 3-5 anni in progetti digitali, organizzativi, regolamentari nel settore Banking Laurea in discipline economiche o scientifiche Conoscenza dell'ambito Canali Digitali, in particolare: funzionamento Mobile App; competenze UX e UI; logiche front to back di un CJ Padronanza della gestione del budget relativamente a progetti in ambito tecnologico Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese (fluent) Project Management Esperienza nell'utilizzo di strumenti AI e LLM Eccellente conoscenza Microsoft Office Esperienza nel lavoro in Team e nella partecipazione a progettualità interdisciplinari ad elevata complessità Capacità di analisi rischi e impatti Costituisce titolo preferenziale aver svolto percorsi di studio e/o lavoro in ambito internazionale Cosa ti offriamo Retribuzione annua lorda a partire da 40.000 € Il Gruppo prevede una componente variabile della remunerazione così come disciplinata dalle Politiche di Remunerazione consultabili sul sito di Gruppo Elementi complementari disciplinati dal Contratto Collettivo Nazionale Credito e accordi aziendali di secondo livello Iniziative di sviluppo professionale a supporto della crescita delle nostre persone Ampia offerta formativa tramite la Corporate Academy dedicata allo sviluppo continuo delle competenze professionali, manageriali e trasversali a tutti i livelli Possibilità di aderire al lavoro flessibile e alla settimana corta 4x9 Sistema moderno e integrato di welfare aziendale ( link ) Copertura sanitaria e previdenza complementare a decorrere dall’assunzione Vantaggi sui prodotti e servizi bancari del Gruppo Chi siamo Siamo leader in Italia e uno dei principali gruppi bancari in Europa. Unisciti a noi e fai parte della nostra storia di successo! Con oltre 20 milioni di clienti in Italia e all'estero siamo un vero e proprio motore di crescita sostenibile con un forte impegno per l'ambiente e un impatto tangibile sulla società. Le persone sono al centro, ce ne prendiamo cura impegnandoci nel creare una cultura inclusiva all'interno del Gruppo in cui tutti si sentano protagonisti e valorizzati. L’Area Chief Data, A.I. & Technology Officer è la realtà IT del Gruppo che coniuga l’agilità di una fintech con la solidità di un grande gruppo; avrai l'opportunità di lavorare in un contesto innovativo con tecnologie all’avanguardia e con forte spinta alla trasformazione digitale. Unisciti alla nostra realtà internazionale. Il futuro non si aspetta, si sceglie! #sharingfuture Garantiamo un ambiente inclusivo e di pari opportunità. title: Senior Manager - Indirect Sales Channel
motivazione: Il candidato possiede la lingua italiana e inglese richieste e opera a Milano, quindi non ha requisiti bloccanti. Ha esperienza nella gestione di team cross‑funzionali, nella costruzione di sistemi di lead generation e nella definizione di strategie di go‑to‑market, competenze utili per la gestione di canali indiretti. Tuttavia, l’annuncio richiede un’esperienza consolidata di 7+ anni in B2B sales con ruolo di Area/Channel Manager e una comprovata capacità di costruire e motivare reti di Field Consultants, agenzie e rivenditori, soprattutto nei settori HoReCa e retail. Il CV non evidenzia esplicitamente tali network di partner indipendenti né la gestione di commissioni e incentivi specifici per agenzie, rappresentando il gap più rilevante.
testo_completo: Milan, Italy Hybrid About us Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance. That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what’s broken — you’ll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you’ll build something worth being proud of. What you’ll be doing As our Senior Manager - Indirect Sales Channel, you’ll build and scale the network of partners that brings our solutions to as many merchants as possible across the territory. You’ll report directly to the Head of Business Development and own our distribution strategy through third-party partners. You’ll look after the full lifecycle of our external sales partners, with one clear goal: growing our market footprint. Here’s what that looks like in practice: Network building - Scout, recruit and onboard a wide commercial network of independent Field Consultants, master agencies and authorized reseller shops. Channel strategy - Design and run the go-to-market plan for the indirect channel: pick the best territories, set commission structures and define the partner profiles that help us scale. Partner enablement - Be the main point of contact for our partners. Train them on our solutions and give them the commercial materials to sell with confidence. Targets and performance - Set ambitious sales targets, track how each partner is performing and put incentive plans in place to keep agencies and Field Consultants engaged and productive. Field presence - Travel across the territory with an Area Manager approach to meet key agencies and major retail resellers, strengthen relationships and help them sell more. Who we’re looking for This role needs someone who has built external sales networks before and knows how to keep independent partners motivated, selling and growing. Experience - 7+ years in B2B sales, with a good part of it as Area Manager, Channel Manager or Indirect Sales Manager. Network building - Proven track record of structuring, scaling and managing networks of independent Field Consultants and commercial agencies from the ground up. Channel knowledge - Hands-on knowledge of retail, hotels, restaurants and cafés (HoReCa) and local shops, and of how to reach them through third-party partners. Product sales - Experience selling B2B products, commercial equipment or business solutions through external networks, with a focus on getting products adopted. Strategy and analytics - Able to negotiate commercial terms with agencies, build profitable commission models and read regional sales data to improve territory coverage. Languages - Full professional fluency in Italian and English, written and spoken. Don’t worry if you don’t tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you’re passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply. CareAbout: how we support your impact We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout: ❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops. 💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries. ⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply. 🌱 Flexibility: unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy*, flexible working hours. 👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness. *We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time. Initial salary: Starting from €50,000 gross per annum (+ variable) This baseline is set using objective, gender-neutral criteria for the role’s core requirements. However, we do not believe in putting a ceiling on talent. The final compensation package is tailored according to your unique experience and expertise. If your skills go beyond the standard profile, apply anyway so we can discuss a package that reflects your true value. Equal opportunity employer At Satispay, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds. This opportunity is open to everyone, regardless - for instance - of race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and national origin. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers. Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY). This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub. This role provides dedicated Business Development support for NVIDIA-Lenovo AI solutions across Europe, helping accelerate partner AI readiness, drive pipeline growth, and scale repeatable AI enablement programs. The position works closely with NVIDIA, Lenovo regional sales teams, channel partners, and strategic alliances to execute a unified go-to-market strategy across Intelligent Devices Group (IDG), Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG), and Solutions Services Group (SSG). The ideal candidate combines business development expertise, alliance management experience, and a strong understanding of AI-related technologies and partner ecosystems. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain strong relationships with NVIDIA, Lenovo teams, channel partners, and strategic alliances across the Europe region. Co-create and execute joint business plans with NVIDIA and strategic partners to drive growth and achieve agreed objectives. Manage and monitor the sales pipeline, ensuring accurate forecasting, reporting, and business visibility. Conduct regular business reviews with NVIDIA stakeholders, sharing performance data, program updates, and partner engagement outcomes. Support strategic customer engagements and executive meetings by providing business and solution expertise. Collaborate across sales, alliance, and business unit teams to ensure effective execution of AI-focused initiatives. Promote best-practice sharing and innovative approaches that strengthen partner readiness and program adoption. Track program performance through dashboards and reporting tools and provide regular performance updates to key stakeholders. Position Requirements Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in Business, Sales, Technology, or a related field. 6-8 years of experience in business development, sales, alliance management, or a related role. Proven success working with large international partners across multiple European markets. Strong understanding of enterprise technology solutions, preferably within AI, infrastructure, or partner-led ecosystems. Ability to effectively present and advocate Lenovo-NVIDIA solutions to senior business and technical stakeholders. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. Strong collaboration, relationship-building, and stakeholder-management capabilities across functions and geographies. Preferred: Experience in a regional alliance or strategic partnership role, with strong pipeline management and business planning expertise. What Lenovo Can Offer You Be part of a global technology leader driving innovation across devices, infrastructure, services, AI and digital workplace solutions Help customers solve real business challenges and deliver meaningful outcomes through technology. Collaborate with experienced sales, technical and specialist teams across Lenovo's global organisation. Work at the forefront of emerging technologies, helping organisations navigate AI adoption, digital transformation and the future of work. Access development opportunities, specialist training and diverse career paths across a growing global business. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any federal, state, or local protected class. Segnala offerta di lavoro Johnson Controls delivers fire and security solutions that help customers protect people, assets, and operations. In this role, you will lead delivery across Italy with a strong focus on project execution, commercial performance, and customer satisfaction. What You Will Do We are looking for an Operations Manager to oversee fire and security projects in Italy and manage a team of project and site managers. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone with experience in Mechanical and Electrical installation projects, strong people leadership skills, and a solid commercial mindset. Fire and security experience is preferred, but not essential. How You Will Do It Lead and coordinate a team of project managers and site managers across active projects. Oversee the delivery of Mechanical and Electrical installation projects from planning through completion. Ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within scope, and in line with commercial targets. Monitor project progress, resource use, risks, and performance across multiple sites and workstreams. Support commercial management activities such as forecasting, cost control, change management, and margin protection. Work closely with customers, internal teams, and suppliers to maintain strong working relationships and resolve issues quickly. Support site execution, quality control, and compliance with company processes and project requirements. Develop team capability through clear direction, coaching, and regular performance follow-up. Required What we look for Proven experience managing operations, project delivery, or installation teams in a mechanical and electrical environment. Experience managing Mechanical and Electrical installation projects. Strong people management experience, including leading project managers and site managers. Strong commercial management skills, including budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and margin awareness. Ability to manage multiple priorities, resolve issues, and maintain delivery momentum across several projects. Confident stakeholder management skills with customers, suppliers, and internal teams. Fluent English and Italian language skills, both written and spoken. Preferred Experience in fire and security projects. Exposure to integrated building systems, project controls, or multi-site project delivery. Experience working in a customer-facing environment with responsibility for both operational and commercial outcomes. Per questo, siamo alla continua ricerca di talenti, in tutti gli ambiti, che possano condividere la filosofia e supportare il percorso di sviluppo dell'azienda. In questo momento stiamo cercando uno/una Emea Retail Manager. Rispondendo al Global retail manager, il Emea Retail Manager sarà responsabile di assicurare l’eccellenza operativa, il raggiungimento degli obiettivi commerciali e il mantenimento di uno standard elevato di customer experience, in linea con il posizionamento del brand nel segmento lusso. La persona ideale è motivata, orientata ai risultati e dotata di una solida esperienza nel retail di alta gamma, preferibilmente nel settore calzature. Con un forte senso di leadership e una spiccata attitudine al people management, contribuirai attivamente alla crescita del business, promuovendo al contempo un ambiente di lavoro positivo e stimolante per i team di vendita. Rispondendo al direttore retail, lavorerà a stretto contatto con i vari dipartimenti organizzativi ed avrà il compito di monitorare costantemente le performance dei negozi milanesi, individuare aree di miglioramento e proporre soluzioni efficaci per garantire l’eccellenza operativa e commerciale. Responsabilità principali Supervisionare e coordinare le attività dei punti vendita, assicurando l’implementazione delle strategie commerciali e il raggiungimento degli obiettivi di vendita; Supervisionare l’intera rete retail EMEA, assicurando l’eccellenza operativa e la coerenza con gli standard del brand; Gestire i team dei negozi diretti, supportando Store Manager e collaboratori nel raggiungimento degli obiettivi; Garantire un’eccellente customer experience in linea con i valori del brand; Monitorare KPI di vendita, conversione, traffico e produttività, proponendo azioni correttive dove necessario; Gestire e supportare Store Manager e team retail nella formazione, motivazione e sviluppo; Assicurare la corretta applicazione delle linee guida aziendali e delle procedure operative; Reclutare , formare e motivare il personale; Stabilire relazioni solide con i clineti VIP e promuovere esperienze esclusive per fidelizzarli. Requisiti Esperienza consolidata (5+ anni) in ruoli di responsabilità nel retail di lusso; Eccellenti capacità di leadership, gestione del team e problem solving; Forte orientamento al cliente e al risultato; Ottime capacità organizzative e relazionali. La sede di lavoro è prevista a Milano (MI) con una modalità in presenza. Il range retributivo lordo indicativo si colloca tra i 75.000 e i 85.000 euro annui, in base all’esperienza maturata dal candidato. Completano l’offerta un pacchetto di benefit che include ticket pasto. Segnala offerta di lavoro Please Note: If you are a current Spin Master employee with access to Workday, apply to this job via the Workday application. Are you a kid at heart looking to build a career with a leading global children's toy, entertainment and digital gaming company? At Spin Master, our unwavering commitment to open mindedness, integrity and innovation is a great part of what has made us an industry leader. How do we stay ahead of the pack? By hiring the best and brightest minds—and that’s why we want you! Job Description What will you work on? The Junior Brand Manager is responsible for marketing strategies of existing brands and future brand launches with the goal to develop and grow a business which will generate a sustainable and profitable business for the long term. Junior Brand Manager is responsible for developing and executing Marketing strategies including brand plans, product line selection, ATL/BTL plans and retail execution. How will you create impact? Brand Strategy/Implementation Co-develop and implement the Spin Master brand strategies including all aspects of the marketing mix/tools Define the product line considering the competitive landscape and retail environment. Support the growth of our market shares in a sustainable way by launching new brands and expand existing brands Support in maintaining the TLP (toy line projection) together with quota management. Drive effective brand plans to communicate the brand through the most appropriate media Optimize the on-line web-opportunities in an effective and creative way Strong alignment with the European brand teams, the support teams in Bratislava and the Global Business Units in US and Canada Budget Management Manage and control the marketing budget for your respective brands regarding all the implemented activities Marketing services / PR Align with the PR agency what the most appropriate PR activities in order to support your brands Scout and collaborate with marketing services agencies for the development/execution of marketing plans, including assets production (POS material, adaptations etc.) Have a detailed understanding of the kids media landscape and know how to interpret/ validate the recommendations from the agencies Market/consumer knowledge Gain a thorough understanding of the Spin Master brands and be able to benchmark this with the market situation Ensure to keep the organization up to date with trends and changes in the competitive landscape What are your skills and experience? University or Bachelor Degree 2-3 years branded consumer marketing experience, preferably in the kids/toys industry or FMCG/retail Experience with the toy trade Creative mindset in combination with a hands-on attitude Strong written, verbal and presentation skills Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize work without missing critical deadlines Ability to both adapt to and manage changing priorities independently in a fast-paced environment Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively within a team environment Intermediate to advanced knowledge of MS Office, coupled with excellent organizational communication skills, and customer service skills Proven ability to do whatever it takes to get the job done while taking initiative and pushing projects forward under tight deadlines Fluent in English written and verbal Passionate about creative excellence and willing to drive self and others to achieve “magic” Domestic and International travel required at times # LI-MK1 This job posting is tied to an open vacancy. What You Can Expect From Us Our mission is to Make Life More Fun with a vision to push the boundaries of innovation, creativity, and fun. Growth and Career Opportunities Flexible Work Hours Innovation, Collaboration and Fun Comprehensive Benefits Other fun Perks! What’s it like to work here? Spin Master is a fast-paced, hands-on organization that provides many great opportunities for impactful decision-making; though our challenging start-up atmosphere isn’t for everyone, we have a proven record of opportunities for future advancement and internal transfers for our passionate and results driven team. Everyone is welcome in our sandbox and we are committed to an accessible and inclusive hiring process that provides reasonable accommodation to all applicants. Spin Master strives to create an accessible and inclusive application and selection process and is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to job applicants who may require provisions to participate in the recruitment, selection and/or assessment processes. Should you require an accommodation, please contact our Talent Acquisition team, by email at JobsEU@spinmaster.com and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs. We do appreciate all interest; however only those selected for interview will be contacted.
