Esperienza concreta su GEO / AI Search, o un interesse forte e dimostrabile per il tema. Ottima padronanza di Google Search Console, GA4, Screaming Frog, SEMrush o Ahrefs (o strumenti equivalenti). Capacità di dialogare sia con i team tecnici sia con le figure marketing e brand. Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Plus: esperienza su brand fashion, luxury o retail, oppure su siti e-commerce multi-mercato. 📍 Dettagli operativi Impegno: full time. Modalità: ibrida, con 2 giorni a settimana in presenza a Milano . Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Office When you’re part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll do challenging work, and join a team that values performance, quality and innovation. As part of a successful, growing global organization you will be encouraged to perform at your best. With revenues of more than $40 billion and the largest investment in R&D in the industry, we give our people the resources and chances to create significant contributions to the world. The job: The Director, Product Management & Service Operations will lead the integration of product management with service delivery training in the US and EMEA. The role ensures alignment between product portfolios, service operations, and commercial teams to support customer requirements, operational efficiency, and growth across the regions. The director will be responsible for strategy, execution, and team leadership across both functions. This role is fully remote (working from home), based anywhere in Italy or the UK. Some international travel will be required across EMEA and the US– between 25% to 50% of working time - including overnight stays. What will you do? Strategy and Portfolio Management Define and implement an integrated product and service strategy globally. Align product lifecycle management with service readiness, training, and support requirements. Develop prioritization frameworks to guide new product and service initiatives. Partner with regional and global stakeholders to ensure consistency with business objectives. New Product Introduction (NPI/NSI) and Go-to-Market. Oversee planning and readiness for new product and service introductions. Ensure product and service roadmaps incorporate customer and market insights. Provide oversight for financial elements including pricing corridors, forecasts, and ROI assessments. Partner with Business Development and Sales to establish go-to-market strategies and launch plans. Operations and Execution Monitor and improve operational processes, and service delivery. Streamline reporting structures and optimize spans of control where appropriate. Ensure alignment across product management, service, and commercial teams to improve execution. Oversee lifecycle management including end-of-life (EOL) plans and service transitions. Customer and Market Focus Support the translation of customer needs into product and service solutions. Ensure integrated solutions maintain relevance and meet expectations throughout the lifecycle. Drive alignment of product and service functions to support overall customer experience. Leadership and Team Development Lead and develop a team of Product Managers and Service Operations leaders. Establish forums and processes to support collaboration and performance management. Create opportunities for skill development, scope expansion, and career progression within the team. Who we are looking for: 15+ years of experience in product management, service operations, or related functions. Background in the Life Sciences industry, or another highly technical industry. Experience integrating product and service strategies within a matrixed or regional organization. Demonstrated success leading cross-functional teams and implementing organizational changes. Experience with product and service launch planning and lifecycle management. Strong financial and operational management experience, including forecasting and ROI analysis. Strategic planning and execution. Customer and market orientation. Stakeholder management and influencing. Operational discipline and process improvement. Team leadership and talent development. Works in an office environment. Frequent domestic and international travel required, between 25% to 50% of working time, including overnight stays. What’s in it for you: We offer competitive remuneration, an annual incentive plan bonus scheme and a range of employee benefits! Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding careerand development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation. Warehouse Commercial & Dispatch Manager Role Purpose We are looking for a commercially oriented Warehouse & Dispatch Manager to manage customer order execution from the warehouse through to final dispatch and invoicing. Our technologies help retailers update pricing and product information in real time, improve in-store operational efficiency and digitalize the shopping experience. To strengthen our EMEA commercial team, we are looking for a Sales Account to support the EMEA Sales Manager . Build and maintain relationships with buyers, store operations managers, IT teams and purchasing departments within retail chains. Support pipeline growth and the achievement of assigned sales targets. Who we are looking for Junior/Mid-level professional with at least 2 years of sales experience , preferably in international B2B environments. Previous experience selling technology, retail solutions, hardware, IoT, automation, logistics or products for large-scale retail is a strong plus. Experience in partner management, channel sales or working with system integrators is highly valued. Knowledge of the Italian and European retail market and major retail chains is highly valuable, although not mandatory. Strong relationship-building skills, ability to manage complex negotiations and work with international stakeholders. English and Italian languages are essential for the role. Availability to work full-time from the Morbio Inferiore office. What we offer A meaningful role within a growing international retail technology company. Direct exposure to the EMEA Sales Manager and the opportunity to contribute to European market development. Strong knowledge of monitoring and event management platforms such as Dynatrace, or a comparable enterprise platform, is essential, alongside experience with ITSM processes, vendor management and budget oversight. Experience in a regulated financial services environment will be highly valuable. In return, you will take genuine ownership of a strategic service, shape the future of observability, automation and AI-driven operations, and work with senior stakeholders across engineering, operations and the business, with the flexibility of hybrid working. Sarai inserito/a all'interno di un team tecnico dedicato alla gestione, al supporto e all'evoluzione di una piattaforma applicativa enterprise , lavorando su sistemi distribuiti e servizi di integrazione.
